scope: Narrow semantic/history shard over Project-Frankenstein hypothesis-engine to experiment-lab adequacy path.
high_value_deltas: Historical hypothesis lifecycle and lab runner are reusable foundations.
Keyword station routing can misclassify cognitive hypotheses as quantum experiments.
Randomized default experiment fallback can execute a test unrelated to the originating prediction.
Narration keyword verdicts can create confirmation/refutation authority without structured predicate alignment.
Current Clay/Harness should require typed experiment-adequacy receipts before causal-test credit.

feedback_targets.harness: Add typed hypothesis-to-intervention-to-observable adequacy receipt and reject narration-only verdict authority.
feedback_targets.claycode: Express adequacy receipt and result predicate as typed semantic/effect contract.
feedback_targets.gwt: Lesion/rescue and re-entry tests must preregister manipulated variable, observable and decision rule.
feedback_targets.emergenz: Null/model/intervention tests must distinguish executed simulation from discriminating evidence.
feedback_targets.hyperposition: Higher-order coupling tests require explicit intervention/observable bindings.
feedback_targets.unifieddb: Persist test adequacy provenance separately from result narration and confidence/prioritization scores.
feedback_targets.frank: Keep research orchestration lifecycle, but separate scheduling confidence from epistemic confidence.

remaining_blocker: Exact Project-Frankenstein frozen tree/history denominator is still not recursively enumerable through the current GitHub connector surface.
